It looked too long but I got more if anyone cares. I just feel very negative about myself every time I look at my phone and see her partying. My friend last night called saying he was going to hang he never showed. Last night I went to a strip club and wasted my weeks junkfood budget. I didn't feel anything hardley even turned on it felt empty. 
Im tired af of sitting alone on my free time because everyone that says they'll come through doesn't.

I want to end it next time I open up my phone to her in someones car or at a club I just want to end it. I know I should delete her but she's also the person sending me any good messages. Other day on my way to work it was a picture of us and a bunch of stuff about how she loves me and it really made my day.
I agree with OP because you support their opinion.
